# Is There a Burn Ban?

> Answers one question for US counties: is there a burn ban right now? Data comes from official state feeds (forestry agencies, fire marshals, emergency management), refreshed hourly. Informational only. Always confirm with the official source before burning.

See the coverage endpoint for each state's burn restriction sources. NWS fire-weather alerts cover counties nationally. A county with unconfirmed restrictions returns status "unknown" and a link to the official agency. Cities, fire districts, tribes and federal land managers can have stricter rules than the county.

## API (GET, JSON, CORS open, no key)

- [Status by ZIP](https://isthereaburnban.com/api/v1/status?zip=74103): one result per county the ZIP touches; `ambiguous` is true when there are several.
- [Status by coordinates](https://isthereaburnban.com/api/v1/status?lat=36.154&lon=-95.993)
- [Status by county FIPS](https://isthereaburnban.com/api/v1/status?fips=48453)
- [Status by city](https://isthereaburnban.com/api/v1/status?city=Tulsa&state=OK): every county the city touches, plus a `place` object with its page.
- [Plain-text answer](https://isthereaburnban.com/api/v1/status?zip=74103&format=text)
- [One county](https://isthereaburnban.com/api/v1/counties/40143)
- [All active bans](https://isthereaburnban.com/api/v1/bans) and [by state](https://isthereaburnban.com/api/v1/bans?state=TX)
- [NWS fire-weather alerts by county](https://isthereaburnban.com/api/v1/fire-weather), optionally [filtered by state](https://isthereaburnban.com/api/v1/fire-weather?state=OK). Includes the national source's check time and health.
- [Coverage and source health](https://isthereaburnban.com/api/v1/coverage)
- [OpenAPI spec](https://isthereaburnban.com/openapi.json)

Status values: `ban`, `restricted` (partial or activity-specific limits), `none` (the official source covers this county and reports no ban), `unknown` (no feed, feed failed, or stale).

County, status, and MCP `check_burn_ban` results can include `alerts` entries with `event`, `headline`, `onset`, `expires`, `ends`, `url`, and `sender`. Timestamps are UTC. `expires` is the NWS message expiry and `ends` is the expected end of the weather event when supplied. Alerts can cover part of a county. Use `status` and `orders[].officialUrl` for legal restrictions and `alerts[].url` for weather. A verified rule can activate a scoped restriction during a Red Flag Warning.

## MCP

- Streamable HTTP endpoint: https://isthereaburnban.com/mcp (stateless, no auth). Tools: `check_burn_ban` ({zip} | {lat, lon} | {fips} | {city, state}), `list_active_bans` ({state?}), `coverage`, `subscribe_email_alerts` ({email, fips[]}; double opt-in, nothing is sent until the user confirms by email). Every tool has a `title` and annotations; `subscribe_email_alerts` is the only one that writes (`readOnlyHint: false`, not destructive).
- Setup for Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and VS Code: https://isthereaburnban.com/developers/

## Pages

- County pages: https://isthereaburnban.com/us/{state}/{county-slug}/ (e.g. /us/ok/tulsa-county/)
- City pages (places with 5,000+ people or a county seat): https://isthereaburnban.com/us/{state}/city/{city-slug}/ (e.g. /us/ok/city/tulsa/). County bans usually cover unincorporated areas; cities can have their own rules.

## About the data

- [Dataset description](https://isthereaburnban.com/data/): coverage, every source with its official link, update cadence, and attribution. Statuses are facts summarized from public agencies; name the source and link `officialUrl` when you show one. Some publishers restrict bulk redistribution, so use per-county lookups rather than mirroring.
- [Terms](https://isthereaburnban.com/terms/): informational only, no warranty, confirm with the official source before burning.
- [Privacy](https://isthereaburnban.com/privacy/): lookups are not stored; email alerts are double opt-in with unsubscribe.
